name: question-deck
title: Question Deck
description: A questionnaire card on a loose stack: answers spring in, questions slide and the cards behind shuffle.

perf.budget: Each step runs one layout animation and a shuffle spring on the UI thread; at rest nothing animates.

measurements.notes: Most janky frames are the step slide; at rest nothing animates.

a11y.reducedMotion: Questions cross-fade and the stack does not shuffle.
a11y.screenReader: Progress reads "Question 2 of 6"; the question is a header; options are radios; Next is disabled until something is picked.
a11y.touchTarget: Options, Back, Next and Close are at least 44 pt.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add question-deck`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
